title: Book Three · Chapter 30: A Door on the Page
story:
The winter holiday ends, and the students return to school.

A letter from Leo arrived in the last week. His aunt's visitors came for three days. He wrote about a very full dinner table.

On the first morning, Ronan brings a clean notebook. Anna brings her maths book and a loose drawing inside a folder.

At lunch, she takes the drawing out. It shows the front of a house. There is a narrow door and a window above it.

“Your grandmother's house?” Ronan asks.

“Part of it.”

“Did you draw it there?”

“I started there. Then I tried a different door at home.”

She puts another sheet beside the first. The doorway is wider on this one. The window has moved too.

Ronan looks from one to the other.

“Did she change the house?”

“No. Only my paper changed.”

Anna opens her lunch box. There are three small pieces of egg on top of her rice.

“She has dark stairs inside,” she says. “I want to draw those next.”

“With another window?”

“Maybe. I don't know where a new window can go. I need to learn more.”

Ronan takes a bite of his lunch. He looks at the wide door again.

“Do you want to draw houses?”

Anna thinks for a moment.

“I like maths. I like drawing places too. Maybe I want to learn to design buildings.”

“Big ones?”

“Some. Small ones need good doors too.”

Her friend comes over with a book. Anna moves the lunch box away from the drawing before she lets the girl sit.

The book has pictures of buildings. One room has high windows. Light falls across a long table.

Anna looks closely at that picture. She follows the edge of the room with one finger.

“I like this part,” she says.

Ronan leans forward. He can see chairs near the light and shelves along the far wall.

“For books?” he asks.

“Yes. But look at the space between them.”

There is room for people to walk. In Anna's first drawing, the door is very close to the stairs.

She sees him look back at it.

“I know. I need to move that line.”

She does not rub it out now. She puts a small mark beside it and finishes her lunch.

Kai calls from the door. He has the ball under one arm.

Ronan closes his box and stands up.

“Are you coming?” he asks Anna.

“Later. I want to look at two more pages.”

“All right.”

He goes downstairs. At the doorway, another student comes toward him. Ronan steps aside and holds the door.

Behind him, Anna and her friend bend over the picture of the bright room.

Outside, Kai throws the ball. Ronan catches it with both hands and carries it to the grass.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

folder＝文件夹；doorway＝门口、门洞；design＝设计；space＝空间。

## 理解问题

1. Anna的两张房屋图是否表示祖母已经改建房子？
2. 她初步想学什么？她是否已经懂得怎样安排所有门窗和楼梯？

## 读句子

**She puts another sheet beside the first.**

拆开看：She / puts another sheet / beside the first.

她／放下另一张纸／放在第一张旁边。
